newsitem.title: USA: Fund group says Web site gets 1,000 visitors/day.
newsitem.headline: Fund group says Web site gets 1,000 visitors/day.

text.p: Mutual Fund Educational Alliance managing director Michelle Smith said the group's Internet web site is getting about 1,000 investors a day.
Since it was launched on September 3, it has had nearly 500,000 "hits," or visits to its site, she said.
The 300-page site -- http://www.mfea.com -- offers educational and informational areas as well as direct access to home pages of fund firms.
The group said the site has added daily fund pricing for 750 direct-marketed equity and bond funds.
Smith spoke to reporters during the group's annual meeting here. The alliance is a trade association of 41 no-load fund companies.
